scope: All 16 ADAPTER_PENDING requirements, production read-only first; repository review only, no production access

requirements.title: Admin URL exposure restricted
requirements.production_observation: Read effective Admin route, gateway/WAF/access policy and its binding to the actual origin and ingress paths.
requirements.missing_adapter: Gateway/provider reader plus policy evaluator covering alternate origins, proxies and IPv4/IPv6. Optional approved GET probes supplement policy; a denied-source vantage must actually exist.
requirements.result_boundary: PASS only the enumerated ingress policy. A 403/404 from one source does not establish restricted Admin access. GET may produce logs/session state; strict zero-write deployments must use configuration observation only.

requirements.title: Template output is escaped
requirements.production_observation: Parse deployed PHP/PHTML output sinks in HTML text, attributes and URLs.
requirements.missing_adapter: Context-aware PHP/HTML parser, dataflow and installed escaper/trusted-fragment contracts; complete custom template inventory.
requirements.result_boundary: PASS only proven supported sinks. Dynamic templates, plugins and unresolved values remain UNKNOWN; no general XSS-free claim.

requirements.title: Escaping for JS context
requirements.production_observation: Parse deployed PHP-generated JavaScript, HTML script contexts and serializers.
requirements.missing_adapter: Nested PHP/HTML/JS parser and version-bound serializer/escaping semantics.
requirements.result_boundary: PASS only supported contexts whose values and encoding can be proved; escaping method-name presence is insufficient.

requirements.title: Custom controllers and APIs include function-level authorization
requirements.production_observation: Read enabled routes, webapi.xml, ACL declarations, DI/plugins/preferences and actual role/resource grants.
requirements.missing_adapter: Complete route-to-effective-handler resolver and control-flow proof that supported routes enforce the required resource before protected reads/actions.
requirements.result_boundary: Declared ACL and stored grants can be verified separately. Full function-level authorization remains UNKNOWN for unsupported dispatch, plugins or business ownership. Do not execute production bootstrap/controller code to resolve it.

requirements.title: File download and export endpoints require authorization
requirements.production_observation: Read download/export routes, handler code and object ownership/access checks before protected content is returned.
requirements.missing_adapter: Route resolver and source dataflow/control-flow proof from caller identity and object ID to ownership guard and output sink.
requirements.result_boundary: A protected-route declaration is a narrow predicate, not proof of object-level authorization. Do not download real customer documents as a scan probe.

requirements.title: Log rotation configured
requirements.production_observation: Read actual logging sinks, installed rotation/retention rules, timer/cron activation and recent execution status.
requirements.missing_adapter: Host logrotate/systemd, container runtime and managed logging adapters with complete sink mapping and bounded read permissions.
requirements.result_boundary: Verify installed policy and observed execution timestamps, not future success or every historical rotation. Never run logrotate, restart services or force rotation.

requirements.title: Dependency vulnerability remediation plan identifies an actionable resolution
requirements.production_observation: Read deployed package graph, advisory constraints and available fixed releases.
requirements.missing_adapter: Read-only dependency constraint solver with correct platform/lock/repository inputs; no Composer plugins/scripts. Alternative mitigations need independently observable predicates.
requirements.result_boundary: Prove a compatible candidate under collected constraints, not successful application upgrade, behavioral compatibility or efficacy of a declared mitigation. Fresh narrower ID needed.

requirements.title: Enabled high-risk modules are maintained
requirements.production_observation: Read enabled Magento module configuration and map deployed modules to exact package versions and authoritative maintenance status.
requirements.missing_adapter: Complete module/package mapping including app/code modules, bounded module.xml/registration parsing and explicit high-risk policy plus fresh maintenance provider.
requirements.result_boundary: High-risk is a technical policy input, not a fact inferred from names. No vendor data or unmatched enabled module => UNKNOWN.

requirements.title: Known-exploited packages prioritized (CISA KEV)
requirements.production_observation: Match production package/advisory CVE identities against a dated complete KEV feed.
requirements.missing_adapter: Authoritative feed provenance/freshness, CVE alias resolution and complete advisory-to-installed-version mapping; technical remediation priority/SLA if priority is assessed.
requirements.result_boundary: A verified KEV match is actionable. Absence is meaningful only within complete mapped advisory coverage; a generic known_exploited flag is insufficient. Prioritization is distinct from absence of KEV.

requirements.title: Marketplace extensions are current and maintained
requirements.production_observation: Compare installed extension identities/versions with releases compatible with the deployed Magento/PHP versions.
requirements.missing_adapter: Marketplace/vendor read-only release provider, identity mapping, compatibility and lifecycle metadata with explicit freshness.
requirements.result_boundary: Latest version is not automatically safest/compatible. Unsupported private vendors or missing compatibility data remain UNKNOWN.

requirements.title: Marketplace extensions have vendor support evidence
requirements.production_observation: Read vendor lifecycle and, where available, entitlement status for the exact deployed extension/version.
requirements.missing_adapter: Actual vendor/account read-only API; exact product/account/version binding, expiry and freshness.
requirements.result_boundary: No universal support API is assumed. If the vendor exposes no machine-verifiable status, this provider remains unsupported; no assertion file substitutes for vendor status.

requirements.title: Webhook signature validation present
requirements.production_observation: Read deployed provider module/version, effective webhook configuration and handler paths through SDK verification to protected actions.
requirements.missing_adapter: Stripe/Adyen/current-PayPal adapters plus control-flow and dataflow proof of raw-body/header/endpoint-secret binding, rejection handling and supported replay controls.
requirements.result_boundary: Read-only can prove supported code/config predicates without submitting events. Existing negative diagnostics do not prove enforcement or replay prevention; unresolved paths remain UNKNOWN.

requirements.title: Outbound connections restricted by allow-list
requirements.production_observation: Read complete effective egress rules for the actual application network namespace, CNI/security group and gateways, including IPv4/IPv6 and exceptions.
requirements.missing_adapter: Namespace-bound nftables/iptables/CNI/cloud policy readers and rule-order evaluator matched to a technical destination policy.
requirements.result_boundary: Default DROP alone is insufficient. Do not change firewall rules, use credentialed egress probes or infer every possible network path from one namespace.

requirements.title: Strong TLS ciphers on upstream gateways
requirements.production_observation: Read effective gateway TLS configuration/provider policy; optionally perform bounded TLS handshakes to declared production endpoints/SNI.
requirements.missing_adapter: Gateway/provider adapter plus TLS1.2/1.3 cipher enumerator with recorded client capabilities, coverage and correct ingress binding.
requirements.result_boundary: One negotiated strong cipher is insufficient. Handshakes are active non-business-mutating probes, not passive reads; require rate bounds and explicit probe mode. Missing enumeration capability => UNKNOWN.

requirements.title: API keys stored in env.php (not in DB/plain code)
requirements.production_observation: Resolve declared credentials from effective Magento configuration to environment/file/secret-manager/database provenance without reporting values.
requirements.missing_adapter: Version-bound sensitive config paths, precedence and secret-store metadata adapters; actual credential inventory and narrowly scoped read access.
requirements.result_boundary: Rewrite env.php-only requirement: assess protected approved storage/provenance, not a universal ban on encrypted DB or managed secrets. Do not export raw keys or bootstrap arbitrary project PHP.

requirements.title: SaaS integrations scoped by ACL (least privilege/IP allowlist)
requirements.production_observation: Read active integration identities, effective resource grants, token status and actual ingress/egress policies.
requirements.missing_adapter: Integration-to-ACL/network resolver with explicit expected resource/destination policy; provider metadata reader where relevant.
requirements.result_boundary: Compare observed grants to a technical allow-list. This does not establish business necessity; masked token metadata is enough, token material must not be retained.
